description: Architecture-only paraphrase of NASA/CR-20210017188, sections 11.1 and 11.1.1, printed pages 93–94 (PDF pages 108–109). The eQuad concept has eight electrically isolated battery packs arranged as two packs near each of four motors. A pack represents cells/modules, connectors, contactors, wiring, battery management and thermal-management interfaces. Six pack connections provide stepped-down low-voltage power through DC/DC conversion for flight-control channels. The layout distributes forward and aft sources across three flight-control channels. This summary includes no source failure conditions, FMECA mode/cause/effect rows, probability estimates, criticality values or reference answers. Detailed pack sizing and component choices remain conceptual; this is not a validated vehicle design or complete requirements set. Source: https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20210017188 .
